{
  "name": "adamw",
  "seed": "20260926",
  "initial_value": -2,
  "optimizer": "adamw",
  "lr": 0.1,
  "betas": [
    0.9,
    0.999
  ],
  "eps": 1e-8,
  "weight_decay": 0.01,
  "momentum": 0,
  "dampening": 0,
  "nesterov": false,
  "amsgrad": false,
  "maximize": false,
  "lr_schedule": "constant",
  "lr_final_factor": 0.1,
  "steps": 200,
  "zero_grad_set_to_none": true,
  "accumulation_micro_batches": 1,
  "stop_on_nonfinite": true,
  "dataset": {
    "samples": 512,
    "batch_size": 1,
    "input_min": -2,
    "input_max": 2,
    "target_true_parameter": 1.5,
    "noise_std": 0,
    "shuffle_batches": false,
    "seed": "20260926",
    "walk": "linear"
  },
  "model": {
    "input_scale": 1,
    "output_scale": 1,
    "use_tanh": true
  },
  "landscape": {
    "enabled": true,
    "every": 25,
    "radius": 0.25,
    "points": 17,
    "dtype": "float64"
  },
  "validation": {
    "enabled": true,
    "every": 1,
    "gradient_rtol": 0.000001,
    "finite_difference_rtol": 0.00005,
    "fd_sweep_decades": [
      -10,
      -8,
      -6,
      -4,
      -2
    ],
    "reconstruction_ulp_tolerance": 0,
    "search_update_variants": true
  },
  "stability": {
    "window": 50,
    "update_eps": 1e-12,
    "gradient_eps": 1e-12,
    "stationary_rel": 1e-9,
    "oscillation_min_sign_changes": 3,
    "divergence_loss_growth": 1.05,
    "divergence_absolute": 0.001,
    "stagnant_fraction": 0.5
  },
  "run_fp64_reference_track": true,
  "record_full_state_snapshots": true,
  "live_speed_steps_per_second": 30
}

__all__ = ["AdamW", "adamw"]


class AdamW(Adam):
    def __init__(
        self,
        params: ParamsT,
        lr: float | Tensor = 1e-3,
        betas: tuple[float | Tensor, float | Tensor] = (0.9, 0.999),
        eps: float = 1e-8,
        weight_decay: float = 1e-2,
        amsgrad: bool = False,
        *,
        maximize: bool = False,
        foreach: bool | None = None,
        capturable: bool = False,
        differentiable: bool = False,
        fused: bool | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            params,
            lr,
            betas,
            eps,
            weight_decay,
            amsgrad,
            foreach=foreach,
            maximize=maximize,
            capturable=capturable,
            differentiable=differentiable,
            fused=fused,
            decoupled_weight_decay=True,
        )

    # Preserve decoupled_weight_decay from AdamW for backwards compatibility. The following
    # guarantees that decoupled_weight_decay will always be True for loading any state into
    # AdamW
    def __setstate__(self, state: StateDict) -> None:
        super().__setstate__(state)
        for group in self.param_groups:
            group["decoupled_weight_decay"] = True
